resources.string: Follow these steps to set up and use your mini printer to print receipts.
Bluetooth or USB model recommended for quick checkout printing.
A compact format suitable for counters with limited space.
If you have trouble ordering one, contact us at salesb.groupec.net.
Turn on the printer and connect it to your device via Bluetooth.
Click the three-dot menu > Settings > Service Management > scroll down. Accept the requested permissions.
A new green button appears when recording a sale allowing you to save the sale and print the receipt (Screen: Cash In).
On the My Sales screen, the “Print Receipt” option appears in the menu for a specific sale and allows you to print the receipt for the sale.
Our support team is available to help you configure your checkout hardware.
